data.name: SharePointMetadataGrid_Desc
data.value: Editable grid of SharePoint document metadata for this record's folder, driven by a SharePoint view.

data.name: dummy_Desc
data.value: Required by the manifest only. Bind to any single line of text column.

data.name: clientId_Desc
data.value: Application (client) ID of the SPA app registration. Not a secret.

data.name: viewName_Desc
data.value: Name of the library view whose columns the grid shows.

data.name: libraryName_Desc
data.value: Library title or URL name. Filters document locations; required for the template folder mode.

data.name: siteUrl_Desc
data.value: Absolute SharePoint site URL. Overrides the site resolved from document locations.

data.name: folderMode_Desc
data.value: Where the folder resolution chain starts.

data.name: fallbackTemplate_Desc
data.value: Folder path template, e.g. {library}/{contactnumber}. Tokens are column logical names on the record.

data.name: autoCreateFolder_Desc
data.value: Create the folder from the template (and a document location row) when none exists.

data.name: folderUrlOverride_Desc
data.value: Escape hatch: absolute URL of the SharePoint folder to show.

data.name: columnConfig_Desc
data.value: Per-column overrides: requiredOnUpload, readOnly, hidden, editor, label, default.
